name: IHME GBD Results
description: IHME Global Burden of Disease Results tool metadata: release versions and the full cause, location, age, sex, measure, metric and risk-factor (REI) hierarchies for GBD 2021 and GBD 2023.

tools.name: Hierarchy children
tools.description: Traverse one level down a hierarchy: the direct children of a cause, location or rei node (e.g. GBD region Western Europe to its 24 countries), plus the parent node and its ancestors.

options.name: id
options.about: Parent node id, e.g. location 73 (Western Europe), cause 294 (All causes), rei 169 (All risk factors).

options.name: gbd_round
options.about: GBD round served by the Results tool: 2021 (gbd2021.healthdata.org) or 2023 (vizhub.healthdata.org, current release). Pinned on every record.

options.name: proxy
options.about: Optional runner proxy override {kind: datacenter|residential|mobile, country?, sticky?}. Staging leases datacenter only.

response.about: Traverse one level down a hierarchy: the direct children of a cause, location or rei node (e.g. GBD region Western Europe to its 24 countries), plus the parent node and its ancestors.

fields.name: type
fields.about: cause | location | age | sex | measure | metric | rei.

fields.name: id
fields.about: Stable GBD entity id, shared across rounds.

fields.name: parent_id
fields.about: Parent in the hierarchy; null for roots, flat types and entities outside the tree.

fields.name: level
fields.about: Depth in its tree, 0 = root.

fields.name: iso3
fields.about: Always null: the tool publishes no ISO3 codes.

fields.name: source_updated_at
fields.about: Version release stamp in UTC, or null.

fields.name: tree
fields.about: gbd (official hierarchy), custom (IHME custom region groups) or null.

fields.name: rei_type
fields.about: risk | etiology | impairment | injury n-codes for rei records; null otherwise.

fields.name: most_detailed
fields.about: Source most_detailed flag, or null when absent.

fields.name: sort_order
fields.about: Source sort order, or null.

fields.name: source
fields.about: Raw php/metadata/ entry preserved verbatim (codes such as cause "B.2.2", sex flags, populations).

tools.name: Entity lookup
tools.description: Resolve one entity (cause, location, age, sex, measure, metric or rei) by GBD id in a GBD round: its hierarchy_node record plus ancestors (root first) and direct children.

options.name: id
options.about: GBD entity id, e.g. cause 493 (ischemic heart disease), location 102 (USA), age 27 (age-standardized), rei 99 (smoking).

options.name: gbd_round
options.about: GBD round served by the Results tool: 2021 (gbd2021.healthdata.org) or 2023 (vizhub.healthdata.org, current release). Pinned on every record.

options.name: proxy
options.about: Optional runner proxy override {kind: datacenter|residential|mobile, country?, sticky?}. Staging leases datacenter only.

response.about: Resolve one entity (cause, location, age, sex, measure, metric or rei) by GBD id in a GBD round: its hierarchy_node record plus ancestors (root first) and direct children.

tools.name: Hierarchy page
tools.description: One page of hierarchy_node records for an entity type (cause, location, age, sex, measure, metric, rei) in a GBD round: id, name, parent_id, level, tree placement and the raw source entry. Tree types come in depth-first hierarchy order; page with cursor until next_cursor is null.

options.name: cursor
options.about: next_cursor from the previous page of the same type and gbd_round.

options.name: proxy

tools.name: Release versions
tools.description: List the GBD Results tool release versions (version id, GBD round, release stamp, model description, exposed measure ids) for one or both supported rounds. Use it to pin gbd_round/version_id and read the tool's stated release date.

options.name: gbd_round
options.about: Restrict to one round (2021 or 2023); omit for both.

options.name: proxy
options.about: Optional runner proxy override {kind: datacenter|residential|mobile, country?, sticky?}. Staging leases datacenter only.

response.about: List the GBD Results tool release versions (version id, GBD round, release stamp, model description, exposed measure ids) for one or both supported rounds. Use it to pin gbd_round/version_id and read the tool's stated release date.

fields.name: description
fields.about: IHME model version list as published.

fields.name: release_stamp_raw
fields.about: The tool's own MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM stamp (zone unstated).

fields.name: source_updated_at
fields.about: release_stamp_raw as Seattle local time, in UTC.

fields.name: measure_ids
fields.about: Measure ids this version exposes (source field `metrics`).
